title: Lori P
content: I have no recollection of anything in particular that happened before this experience. As I have explained, my mother was in the hospital with a broken hip after being diagnosed with cancer after battling it for a few years. The only thing I can say is that I was under a great deal of stress because of this. My memory is very vivid after all of these years and I can explain what happened in detail. In the very beginning, I was in a blue and white scene rather than in full-color or black-and-white. I am in a bus full of people. It’s dark and I have been asleep and missed my stop. I get up and walk to the front of the bus to speak to the bus driver about missing my stop. When I reach the front of the bus, I’m holding onto the bars by the driver seat. There are children in the front seat behind the driver. The driver is very heavy and the buttons are pulling at his shirt. As I’m explaining to the driver that I missed my stop and asked if he could let me off at the next stop, there was a sudden gasp from the children behind him and others on the bus. The bus driver slammed on the brakes as I gripped the bars so I didn't lose my balance. When I looked up, I was outside of the bus, hovering in front of the windshield. Everything was in full vivid color. We had reach the very tip of a deep crevice. The bus was teetering at that edge. I could see a small bridge that a person would have to walk very carefully across because it was so thin from one side of this crevice to the other. There was a waterfall to my left, sparkling radiantly with light. Across the crevice was a botanical haven of some sort. It was lush with vividly, beautiful plant life; all having light behind them and dancing lively with a breeze. The bridge that went across the crevice was made of tortoise shells colored with many shades of browns and tans. These shells and colors were filled with light. It not only span across from one end to the other, but was also a wall that went straight down to the bottom of the crevice. It was beautiful. I didn't talk with anyone or see anyone in particular, but they seemed to be alive in the garden in front of me. They also seemed to be alive in the waterfall to my left. Words cannot describe the feeling of joy and being loved, as if my own mother were cradling me. I felt safe, happy, and loved. I remembered this experience right after this happened. I would explain this to people, and it would so often occurred to me that I could not explain my emotions with the words that I had in my vocabulary. I’ve often wondered why I had this experience, that is so like a death experience in many ways. The waterfall, the emotional high, the beauty, and the light were amazing. Being able to remember this experience as if it happened yesterday, all of these things are similar to the NDEs I've read about.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Yes, This came as a dream. I was not injured or ill. My mother was weeks from dying so there was stress., Other (briefly specify), Well but under stress as mentioned above.
elements.Did you feel separated from your body?: I lost awareness of my body
elements.How did your highest level of consciousn: More consciousness and alertness than normal, I can only say that I felt very alive, alert, and happy beyond what words can explain.
elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning, I have no concept of the time during this event.
elements.Please compare your vision during the ex: My vision seemed normal, and the bright light in everything was comforting.
elements.Please compare your hearing during the e: I don’t remember hearing anything after I was off the bus.
elements.Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a br: A light clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin
elements.Did you seem to enter some other, uneart: A clearly mystical or unearthly realm, I was hovering, one foot crossed over the other. The entire scene felt like another world.
elements.Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity: I felt united or one with the world
elements.Did you come to a border or point of no: I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will
elements.What was your religion prior to your exp: Unaffiliated- Nothing in particular- Religious unaffiliated
elements.What is your religion now?: No comment, I was raised Catholic and went to Catholic school for a time. Have not had any personal affiliation with organized religion for many years. Spiritual.
elements.Did your experience include features con: Content that was entirely consistent with the beliefs you had at the time of your experience, I did not experience something I did not know before. I only experienced it in an unusual, incredibly beautiful, and loving way.
elements.Did you have a change in your values and: Yes, I believe kindness and love are very important to share.
elements.Did you seem to encounter a mystical bei: I encountered a definite being, or a voice clearly of mystical or unearthly origin, It seemed the garden beyond the crevice and waterfall to my left had a presence more than just plants and water. There were no words passed, only feelings.
elements.During your experience, did you gain inf: Uncertain, I had an awareness of a connection.
Yes, I remember telling my mother about this experience and felt relieved for her. I’ve always thought I’ve had little fear of death since then.
elements.Have your relationships changed specific: Yes, I am more compassionate and forgiving.
elements.Was the experience difficult to express: Yes, There are no words to fully convey the level of joy and love I felt. The colors in the garden beyond the crevice, the bridge, and the waterfall had a light, radiance, and familiarity. They seemed to know me well, if that makes sense.
elements.How accurately do you remember the exper: I remember the experience more accurately than other life events that occurred around the time of the experience, I remember every detail of that experience. I often meditate there and look around but can only vaguely recall the feelings I had. I know they were beyond extreme with joy and love, but I cannot summon those emotions again as in the experience.
elements.What did you believe about the reality o: Experience was definitely real, I immediately wrote it down, fearing I would forget. But I’ve never looked at that again or even know where it is. It was very real to me, like nothing else in my entire life.
